title: Blog: Mornings on Packed Trains
titleJp: ブログ：満員[まんいん]電車[でんしゃ]の朝[あさ]

sentences.jp: 日本[にほん]に来[き]て、もうすぐ三[さん]か月[げつ]になる。
sentences.en: It's almost three months since I came to Japan.

sentences.jp: 仕事[しごと]にもだいぶ慣[な]れてきたが、どうしても慣[な]れないのが朝[あさ]の満員[まんいん]電車[でんしゃ]だ。
sentences.en: I've gotten fairly used to work, but the one thing I just can't get used to is the packed trains in the morning.

sentences.jp: 私[わたし]が毎朝[まいあさ]乗[の]る路線[ろせん]は、八時[はちじ]前後[ぜんご]になると、ドアが閉[し]まらないほど混[こ]んでいる。
sentences.en: The line I take every morning gets so crowded around eight that the doors barely close.

sentences.jp: 初[はじ]めて乗[の]った日[ひ]は、駅員[えきいん]さんに背中[せなか]を押[お]されて、やっと中[なか]に入[はい]れた。
sentences.en: The first day I rode it, a station attendant pushed me from behind and I finally managed to get on.

sentences.jp: 驚[おどろ]いたのは、そんな状態[じょうたい]でもみんな静[しず]かに立[た]っていることだ。
sentences.en: What surprised me was that even in those conditions, everyone stands there quietly.

sentences.jp: 電話[でんわ]で話[はな]す人[ひと]はほとんどいないし、リュックを体[からだ]の前[まえ]に持[も]つ人[ひと]も多[おお]い。
sentences.en: Hardly anyone talks on the phone, and many people hold their backpacks in front of their bodies.

sentences.jp: 後[あと]で同僚[どうりょう]に聞[き]いたら、それはほかの人[ひと]の迷惑[めいわく]にならないようにするためのマナーだそうだ。
sentences.en: When I asked a coworker about it later, they said it's etiquette so as not to bother other people.

sentences.jp: 最近[さいきん]は、少[すこ]しでも楽[らく]に通勤[つうきん]するために、いくつか工夫[くふう]をしている。
sentences.en: Lately, I've been trying a few tricks to make my commute even a little easier.

sentences.jp: まず、いつもより三十分[さんじゅっぷん]早[はや]く家[いえ]を出[で]るようにした。
sentences.en: First, I started leaving home thirty minutes earlier than usual.

sentences.jp: 七時[しちじ]半[はん]ごろの電車[でんしゃ]なら、座[すわ]れることもある。
sentences.en: On a train around seven thirty, I can sometimes even get a seat.

sentences.jp: それから、一番[いちばん]前[まえ]の車両[しゃりょう]はほかの車両[しゃりょう]より少[すこ]しすいていることにも気[き]がついた。
sentences.en: I also noticed that the very front car is a little less crowded than the others.

sentences.jp: 会社[かいしゃ]によっては、時差[じさ]出勤[しゅっきん]やリモートワークを認[みと]めているところもあるらしい。
sentences.en: Apparently some companies allow staggered working hours or remote work.

sentences.jp: うちの会社[かいしゃ]もそうなってくれたらいいのに、と思[おも]う毎日[まいにち]だ。
sentences.en: Every day I find myself thinking, "I wish my company would do that too."

questions.q: What surprised the writer most about the crowded trains?
choices: That everyone stays quiet even when packed
That the trains are always on time

questions.q: According to the coworker, why do people hold their backpacks in front?
choices: To keep them from being stolen
Because it is a company rule
So as not to bother other passengers
So they can reach their phones easily

questions.q: What has the writer started doing?
choices: Working from home twice a week
